statement: For any direction, support of the original convex hull is attained at an original vertex with projection at least h and norm at most R. Relative to another cog center at distance d, its squared distance is at most d²-2hd+R². The checked convex quadratic is negative on [2r,D], so that vertex lies strictly in the other original filled disk. Distances below2r collide by disk interiors; hence original cog centers must be at leastD apart. A conservative3micrometre loss covers both anchor floor displacements, and the complete Y-domain yields the audited X gap. Each original bracket contains its inset full-height stem. Every support vertex toward either side has transverse distance at most beta, inside the stem Y-range at all allowed continuous positions. Original disk/stem overlap and the two support-tip/stem intervals cover(a-h,c+h), because stem width+r>R. Relative integer rounding is bounded by1micrometre per axis; the weakened stem bounds safely merge with the overlapping audited proxy forbidden interval. These bounds are necessary for full original source continuations, although they need not hold for every earlier inner-proxy-only solution.
